title: Safe plus walls
description: Everything Safe lays, plus walls, window walls and temporary seals, so a breached hull closes up. Doors, hatches, docking ports and bulky machines are still held for Lay held build sites. Unbuilt walls block walking until the crew finish them.

rules.note: Hatches are passages: hold them like doors.
Doors and docking ports are passages too; both carry these tile conditions as well as IsWall.
Walls, window walls, aero walls and blister seals: the HULL tab parts that only carry IsWall.
Floors, conduit and other parts crew can walk over.
